subject: Late planning notes
body:
Planning grid: handover questions

There are two live-looking grids in the folder. Nils can check the shortcut, but Programs needs to identify which staffing proposal was approved. The last-modified date is not a record of agreement.

Please leave unanswered admissions questions visible. When a line becomes a blank cell during a tidy-up, the exported sheet makes it look settled. We then get asked why we didn't provide something we never agreed to provide. Labels matter more than a neat-looking grid.

The time in the agenda heading also needs comparing with the grid before Idris makes the next notice. Otherwise the poster becomes a third version and reception has to guess which one to read aloud.

Finally, green cannot keep meaning checked, proposed and available at the same time. Put the word beside the colour, even if it makes the columns wider. I'll take a wider sheet over another round of explaining that a green proposal wasn't a commitment. Greta
title: Late planning notes
